title: Stacey Kent - Day In Day Out

lines.l: In and day out, day out, day in
I needn't tell you how my days begin
When I awake, I awaken with a tingle
That possibility of maybe seeing you
I see you and to me
The same old hoodoo follows me about, the same old bounding in my heart.
Whenever I think of you, and darling, I think of you, day in and day out.
I needn't tell you how my days begin when I awake
I awaken with a jingle of one possibility in view
That possibility of maybe seeing you
